project_type: WordPress Elementor Plugin + Static HTML Sections
build_system: None (WordPress plugin - manual installation). PHP syntax validation via `php -l`.
test_framework: No automated tests. Validation via `php -l` for PHP files and manual review.
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all PHP files. 2. Visually review JS file for correct Elementor API usage. 3. Verify preset data keys match widget control IDs.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Files are edited directly.
environment_constraints: No WordPress runtime available. No Docker. Validation is limited to PHP syntax checks and code review.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Use RTL direction for all HTML. Use Vazirmatn font.
key_patterns: Each widget uses `Vira_Sections_Preset_Trait` which adds a `vira_preset` SELECT control. The JS `preset-handler.js` listens for changes to this control and applies preset data. Preset data is stored in `class-presets.php` with method names like `get_vira_hero_presets()`. Widget control IDs must exactly match keys in preset data arrays.
directory_structure: Root contains page directories (homepage/, seo-google/, app-android-tabriz/, etc.) each with sections/. The vira-sections-plugin/ contains the Elementor plugin with widgets/, includes/, assets/js/, assets/css/.
